title: IBM CEO sends blunt message on quantum computing

content_html:
I've noticed on several occasions that when a conversation is around transformational technology, the people closest to it speak about it with quiet, almost unsettling certainty.

And then we have everyone else still debating whether it's real. It sounded exactly like that on July 30.

That's when International Business Machines Corporation (IBM) chairman and CEO, Arvind Krishna, sat down with Jim Cramer on Mad Money and made two statements that should stop any serious investor in their tracks.

  1. Quantum computing will have "a measurable impact" on IBM's top and bottom line by 2028 or 2029. 

  2. "By the end of the 2030s, we are now pretty convinced this is a trillion dollars of value."

That's absolutely not some random visionary moonshot speech. That is the CEO putting specific timelines and specific dollar figures on a technology that most of Wall Street still treats as science fiction. 

And just a reminder, Arvind said it less than three weeks after IBM's stock suffered its worst single-day decline on record, on July 14, according to TheStreet.

The timing of Krishna's appearance on Mad Money actually matters here. IBM dropped 25% on July 14 after the company disclosed that some customers had delayed capital spending projects, according to TheStreet. 

The stock has recovered about 2% since then. And Krishna came on national television on July 30, with a dual mission — defend the near-term and make the long-term case louder than ever.

Also Read: History of IBM: Company timeline, milestones & facts

Why IBM's CEO says delayed deals are not dead deals

Let me start with the near-term concern, because it's the one keeping investors up at night.

IBM's Q2 earnings spooked the market. Customer delays in capital spending raised two uncomfortable questions.

  1. Is AI cannibalizing IBM's software business? 

  2. Are enterprise clients broadly pulling back on technology investment?

Krishna addressed both. "Here's the good news: about 40% of them have already closed in three to four weeks," he said, referring to the delayed deals. "That's a good signal that it is a deferral, not a destruction."

That's actually a meaningful data point. If nearly half of delayed projects closed within a month of the earnings announcement, the demand-destruction thesis loses significant force.

  • IBM stock just got a powerful new price target from Wall Street

  • IBM just answered a $5 billion cybersecurity question

  • IBM's latest Wall Street call hides bigger shift

Krishna also reaffirmed full-year guidance, now expecting constant currency revenue growth in the range of four-to-five percent, and free cash flow to increase by about $1 billion year-over-year, according to an IBM statement.

content_html_zh:
我曾多次注意到，当对话围绕变革性技术时，最接近该技术的人会以安静、几乎令人不安的确定性谈论它。

然后我们让其他人仍在争论它是否真实。 听起来和7月30日的情况一模一样。

就在那时，国际商业机器公司 (IBM) 董事长兼首席执行官阿尔文德·克里希纳 (Arvind Krishna) 与吉姆·克莱默 (Jim Cramer) 在 Mad Money 节目中坐下来，发表了两项声明，应该会阻止任何认真的投资者的脚步。

  1. 到 2028 年或 2029 年，量子计算将对 IBM 的营收和利润产生“可衡量的影响”。
  2. “到 2030 年代末，我们现在非常确信这将达到一万亿美元的价值。”

这绝对不是一些随意的、有远见的登月演讲。 也就是说，首席执行官为这项技术制定了具体的时间表和具体的美元数字，而大多数华尔街人士仍将其视为科幻小说。

据 TheStreet 报道，阿温德在 7 月 14 日 IBM 股价遭遇有记录以来最严重单日跌幅后不到三周就发表了上述言论。

克里希纳 (Krishna) 出现在《疯狂金钱》(Mad Money) 节目中的时间在这里实际上很重要。 据 TheStreet 报道，IBM 披露部分客户推迟了资本支出项目后，该公司 7 月 14 日股价下跌 25%。

此后该股已回升约 2%。 克里希纳 (Krishna) 于 7 月 30 日出现在国家电视台，肩负着双重使命——捍卫近期目标，并让长期主张比以往任何时候都更加响亮。

另请阅读：IBM 的历史：公司时间表、里程碑和事实

为什么 IBM 首席执行官表示延迟交易并不是死交易

让我从近期的担忧开始，因为这是让投资者彻夜难眠的问题。

IBM第二季度财报震惊了市场。 客户资本支出的延迟引发了两个令人不安的问题。

  1. AI 正在蚕食 IBM 的软件业务吗？
  2. 企业客户是否普遍撤回技术投资？

克里希纳对两者都发表了讲话。 “好消息是：大约 40% 的交易已在三到四个星期内完成，”他指的是延迟的交易。 “这是一个很好的信号，表明这是推迟，而不是破坏。”

这实际上是一个有意义的数据点。 如果近一半的延迟项目在收益公布后一个月内关闭，那么需求破坏论就失去了重要的力量。

更多IBM：

  • IBM 股票刚刚从华尔街获得了强有力的新价格目标
  • IBM 刚刚回答了价值 50 亿美元的网络安全问题
  • IBM 最新的华尔街电话会议隐藏了更大的转变

根据 IBM 的一份声明，Krishna 还重申了全年指引，目前预计货币收入将持续增长 4% 至 5%，自由现金流将同比增加约 10 亿美元。
